changelog:
nixomatic 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Instantly run any software from nixpkgs without permanent installation or altering your system, using on-demand Nix environments via nixomatic.com URLs.
- Automatically detect and suggest required development tools and runtimes by scanning project files and build manifests.
- Integrates with both Nix and Docker: determines available runtime and provides the correct invocation for each.
- Recommends reusing existing project environments found in README.md or flake.nix; falls back to generating minimal nixomatic environments otherwise.
- Provides clear, safe project analysis rules: never reads secret files, only inspects filenames and safe manifests.
- Includes command templates for both interactive shells and one-shot commands, supporting version and revision pinning.
